scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml up -d mongodb valkey
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml stop mongodb valkey
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml logs -f mongodb valkey
scripts.docker:up: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml --profile full up -d
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml --profile full build
scripts.backup:up: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml --profile full up -d mongodb-backup
scripts.backup:down: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml stop mongodb-backup
scripts.backup:logs: docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml logs -f mongodb-backup
